spawnPlan.briefing: TRIPWIRE T-008 FIRED: planned backlog dropped to 26 (<30 threshold). Generate 40-50 NEW roadmap items derived from docs/ceo-roadmap-2026-05-27.md focused on Q3/Q4 execution gaps. Distribution target: ~30% engineering (CTO), ~20% marketing (CMO), ~15% sales/supply, ~10% CS, ~10% product/UX, ~10% finance/legal/IT, ~5% geo. Each item must have: itemId (follow R-Q3-{CAT}-{NN} or R-Q4-{CAT}-{NN} pattern, skip used IDs in _index.json), title, priority (P0/P1/P2), owner_role, estimated_hours, depends_on[], verify_cmd (REAL shell commands, NO 'TBD-populate'), success_metric, status:planned. Append to docs/roadmap/_index.json. Bias toward items that can be agent-executed (avoid founder-blocker U* dependencies). Reference revenue-line items in CEO roadmap. Write file: docs/roadmap/backlog-refill-2026-06-13.json AND merge into _index.json. CRITICAL: no fabricated verify_cmd — every verify must be a runnable shell command.

Three ready-to-ship engineering items. Execute end-to-end with PRs. R-Q2-E-011: ship the feature per its roadmap spec (check docs/roadmap/_index.json for exact verify_cmd + success criteria). R-Q2-E-013: same. R-Q2-IT-003: observability/infra task. For each: (1) read item spec from _index.json, (2) implement minimal correct change in apps/api or apps/web, (3) add/update tests if applicable, (4) run verify_cmd locally, (5) commit with conventional commit message referencing itemId, (6) update status to 'shipped' in _index.json with shipped_at timestamp + verify_evidence. Respect free-tier budgets. Do NOT introduce new external services without CFO sign-off. If any item has unmet dependency, mark blocked with reason and move on.

Three ready-to-ship marketing items. Read each spec in docs/roadmap/_index.json. Execute: content drafted, scheduled or pushed where automatable (committed to docs/agent-reports/cmo/ as deliverable artifacts), or queued for founder approval where requiring brand voice (mark as 'ready-for-founder-review' if so, not 'shipped'). Focus on India+NRI mix per CEO-roadmap. For SEO content items: write actual markdown drafts to docs/agent-reports/blog-drafts/ with frontmatter (title, slug, target_keyword, meta_description, tags). For distribution items: prepare copy + scheduling plan, do NOT post to external platforms requiring founder credentials. Update _index.json status appropriately (shipped vs needs-founder-review). Verify each via verify_cmd before marking shipped.

Three ready-to-ship supply/sales items focused on temple/pandit/astrologer onboarding pipeline. Read specs in docs/roadmap/_index.json. Most sales items are agent-executable artifact creation (outreach templates, CRM seed lists, WA message scripts, partner playbooks) — NOT actual outbound calls requiring founder. Deliverables: write to docs/agent-reports/sales/ — (1) target lists (CSV with temple name, city, contact source URL, suggested approach), (2) outreach message templates (WA + email + call script in EN/HI), (3) qualification rubric, (4) follow-up cadence playbook. If item requires actual outbound contact, mark 'ready-for-founder-execution' with all artifacts prepared. Update _index.json status. Maintain Varanasi/Bengaluru/Mumbai current-city focus per geo sequencing rule — do not seed new cities until existing ≥80% target.
